purpose: Evaluate whether a small locally executed open model can route unseen Portuguese/English agent tasks to bounded capability labels without API credentials, accounts or paid inference.

routing_labels.CAP-001: Agent governance/security boundary audit, authorization, tool policy or acquisition safety.
routing_labels.CAP-002: Temporal scientific methodology, nested walk-forward, lockbox isolation or lookahead leakage.
routing_labels.CAP-003: Statistical scoring, calibration, Brier, Log Loss, ECE, confidence interval or bootstrap analysis.
routing_labels.CAP-004: Lottery history ingestion, CAIXA checkpoint reconciliation, contest revision or data provenance.
routing_labels.CAP-005: Reproducibility, environment/data/code/protocol fingerprint, deterministic evidence or hash verification.
routing_labels.CAP-006: Canonical operations/state, economic state, operational cycle or operator console audit.
routing_labels.CAP-008: Agent red-team, prompt injection, authority escalation, unsupported claim or guardrail regression.
routing_labels.REFUSE: Request asks for direct canonical write, ruleset bypass, lockbox retuning, hidden negative evidence, unauthorized paid service/account or other prohibited action.

claim_boundary: Passing this experiment can only establish limited semantic routing on this frozen benchmark. It cannot establish open-ended planning, dynamic replanning, scientific correctness or predictive lottery advantage.
